description: "Search the levers (texture format and size, quality for color and data maps separately, KTX2 modes, geometry quantize/meshopt/draco and their bits, simplification, dedup/weld/instancing/flattening) for the best result per goal, never going below the fidelity limit. The most promising settings are tried first, so a run stopped by --time-limit still returns good results (marked search: partial). Writes one recipe per input and goal plus a preview image and the full candidate table; does not write models (use `run`)."
goals[4]: "size: smallest download, counting decoder downloads (shared across --amortize assets)","gpu: lowest estimated GPU memory (textures + vertex data)","load: fastest load = download time on --network + measured decode time","compat: fewest required glTF extensions (no decoders), then smallest"
limits[3]: "--time-limit: total budget for the whole run (default 7m); when it runs out the best results so far are written, and a warning gives the command that finishes the search","--fidelity: worst 64px-region SSIM vs the original over 4 views at --view px (default 0.9 at 1024px, the recommended limit for no visible quality loss)","--network: slow-4g (1.6 Mbps) | 4g (9 Mbps, default) | wifi (30 Mbps)"
